timing: Added after execution and independent review; original protocol and executed source preserved.
anchor_parentheses: The preserved protocol prose omitted outer parentheses; executed code uses Q_anchor - [0.25 * Q_previous + 0.75 * Q_origin]. Both weighted terms are subtracted together.
application_flag: residual_model_applied indicates a computable residual correction. Family status records whether it actually produced a level, failed for negative flow, or retained a missing baseline.
clarification: Finalized describes the retrospective hourly reconstruction used to define a residual, not a reconstruction based exclusively on exact measured forcings. Local rainfall is observed weighted amount plus the uncovered spatial fraction times previous_day1 forecast mean. Its effects persist in HGE states. Upstream inputs use the existing historical grid/asof rules, and missing Carreiro inputs use the frozen regional proxy. These are modeled estimates, not newly observed truth.
target: Reported ANA Q minus that retrospective reconstruction. Training labels can use later known reported Q and historical inputs at the label time; runtime features remain at the anchor or earlier. The candidate does not learn all errors of future upstream and weather forecasts.
scope: No numerical result, training membership, source, cutoff or eligibility flag changed. Source publication availability and physical independence of reported Q from level remain unverified.
